events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the day Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Legacy of a Legend
angles.copy: On this day, we remember Tupac Shakur, a voice that defined a generation. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix's passing.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Today we reflect on the genius of Jimi Hendrix, whose revolutionary guitar playing continues to inspire.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Drop
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles walked across that zebra crossing. 'Abbey Road' still sounds as fresh as ever.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th Birthday to The Pretenders frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde.

angles.name: Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th to the inimitable Chrissie Hynde. Her voice and attitude are pure rock 'n' roll.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Mad for it!
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that unmistakable swagger to the music scene.

events.title: Imagine's Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: A Song for Peace
angles.copy: 49 years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine' – a powerful message that still resonates globally.

events.title: iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Music in your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed how we listen to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini to 007 and the enduring legacy of the world's most famous spy.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: A True Innovator
angles.copy: On his 86th birthday, we celebrate the life and music of John Lennon, a visionary artist whose impact is still felt today.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unparalleled.

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Masterpiece
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental classic that proved their versatility.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Today, we honour the incredible life and legacy of Freddie Mercury. A performer like no other, his music lives on.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A New Direction
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' marked a significant shift in their sound, paving the way for future masterpieces.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: His Message Endures
angles.copy: On this poignant anniversary, we remember John Lennon and his enduring message of peace, love, and understanding.
